items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Her name was Miss McCarthy. And she'd come and, you know, would teach us singing

ctx.x: No, not really. There was a singer teacher who used to come up there from down at the White school. Her name was Miss McCarthy. And she'd come and, you know, would teach us singing, like, you know, Do-Re-Me-Fa-Sol-La-Te-Do; E-G-B-D-F. I didn't pay any mind to the E-G-B-D-F thing; you know, the (?) like that. Do-Re-Me-Fa-Sol-La-Te-Do was easy for me, so that's the way I learned, you know. So I pulled(?) my sounds like that, and then out of my horn, that's where I... Wherever "do" was at, if it was in the key of…
Did anybody ever teach you the positions and all that stuff?
